slides.headline: Undercharging? Let AI pressure-test your price.
slides.badge_text: steps to a price you can defend.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: AI guesses. It knows nothing about you.
slides.right: Give it numbers and real pages

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Describe the offer
slides.card: I sell [service] to [client type]. They get [result]. List what is included and what is not.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Count your real time
slides.card: Estimate my true hours per project, including calls, revisions and admin. Ask me what I forgot.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Find your floor price
slides.card: I need [income] a month from [N] client hours a week. What is my minimum project price?

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Check the market
slides.card: Here are 3 competitor pricing pages. Compare their offers and prices to mine.
slides.note: Use real pages, not AI memory.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Offer 3 options
slides.card: Turn my offer into 3 packages: basic, standard, premium. Explain what each includes.
slides.note: The final price is your call.

slides.headline: Send this to a friend who undercharges.

scenes.headline: AI that only answers from your files.

scenes.title: Gemini Notebook
scenes.footer: Websites and YouTube links work too

scenes.title: TRY THIS PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Using only my sources: where do these 3 documents disagree? List each difference, which source says it, and what I should clarify with the client.
Save this for your next client project.
scenes.note: Remove private details before you upload client files.
